labels.name: Comment
labels.description: A remark. Act on it if it asks for something; otherwise acknowledge it.

labels.name: Question
labels.description: Answer it in the page; do not edit the file for it.

labels.name: Change
labels.description: Rewrite the quoted text as the comment describes.

labels.name: Insert here
labels.description: Insert the comment's text at this point.

labels.name: Looks good
labels.description: Approved as it stands; change nothing.

labels.name: Not this
labels.description: Rejected as it stands; drop it, or propose another way if one is obvious.

labels.name: Seek
labels.description: Find in the document what the comment describes and answer by highlighting it: a mark set named "seek: …", one mark per finding with a short note, listed in the left pane. Reply in one line only, saying how many were found.

labels.name: Setting
labels.description: Change or add a setting of edit-md itself. Find it with `edit-md settings` and change it with `edit-md settings --set KEY=VALUE`, kept for this PC unless the comment asks for the repo; the open page shows it at once. When no setting fits, reply with the setting you would add instead of changing code.

labels.name: Customize the page
labels.description: Change how the review page itself looks or behaves, cosmetic or deeper. Copy each file you change from the installed client (`~/.claude/bin/edit-md/client/`) into the overlay folder `~/.claude/edit-md/client/` and edit the copy there: the server serves it instead, and a reinstall keeps it. Reply with the files you changed; a reload shows them.

labels.name: New comment kind
labels.description: Add a comment kind, a label: write it into the repo's `<git root>/.claude/edit-md/comment_labels.json`, or into `~/.claude/edit-md/comment_labels.json` when the comment says it is the reviewer's own, and check it with `edit-md labels <docId>`. Reply with what it does; a reload shows it.
